title: aggregator(roadmap-annotations): body cap splits surrogate pairs — validateNewRoadmapAnnotation raw-slices at 20,000, bypassing the #7731 capUnits guard

labels.name: kind/bug
labels.description: Something isn't working (prefixed form of the classic bug label)

labels.name: task/small-fix
labels.description: Queue packet kind: bounded fix with reproduction and targeted tests

body:
## Summary

`validateNewRoadmapAnnotation` caps the annotation body with a raw UTF-16 slice, so an astral character straddling the 20,000-unit cap is cut in half and the stored annotation body ends in a lone high surrogate. This is the #7694/#7711/#7725/#7731 defect class in the one aggregator text store those fixes did not reach.

## Evidence

- `pm-stack/aggregator/src/roadmap-annotations.ts:67` (main `722fbe8aa2`):
  ```ts
  body: value.body.trim().slice(0, 20_000),
  ```
  Every sibling validator now caps pair-safely: `actions.ts` `cleanText`/`markResult` (#7694/#7711), `activity.ts` summaries (#7725), and `comments.ts` `validateAuthor`/`validateNewComment` (#7731, a local `capUnits` helper at `comments.ts:94`). `roadmap-annotations.ts` imports the shared `validateAuthor` from `comments.ts` — so its author fields are pair-safe after #7731 — but its **body** cap is its own raw slice in this module and was not part of the #7731 fix.
- The validated value is persisted verbatim by `RoadmapAnnotationsStore` to the roadmap-annotations JSON store (`config.ts:142`, `roadmap-annotations.json`) and rendered on the roadmap timeline (`render.ts:1693`).

## Verification (this run, laptop primary @ `722fbe8aa2`)

Probe `~/git/fleet/probe-roadmap-events-surrogate/probe.ts` (laptop), importing the real `validateNewRoadmapAnnotation`:

- Body = `a`×19,999 + 😀 (U+1F600) + `b`×100 → validator returns `ok`, body length 20,000, **last code unit `0xd83d` (lone high surrogate)**; a UTF-8 encode/decode round-trip of the stored body contains U+FFFD.
- Control: body = `a`×19,998 + 😀 (pair ends exactly at 20,000) → returned intact, no lone surrogate, no U+FFFD.

## Why it matters

Roadmap annotations are the durable decision/outcome record rendered on the timeline. A body that hits the cap with an emoji (or any astral character) at the boundary is silently stored corrupted — the character renders as U+FFFD everywhere the annotation is read back as UTF-8. The four sibling occurrences of this exact class were all treated as bugs worth fixing; this is the residual door in the same store family.

## Acceptance criteria

- [ ] `validateNewRoadmapAnnotation` caps the body pair-safely: an astral character straddling the 20,000-unit cap is dropped whole (result ≤ 19,999 units), mirroring the local `capUnits` pattern used in `comments.ts`/`actions.ts`/`activity.ts`.
- [ ] Regression tests in `pm-stack/aggregator/test/roadmap-annotations.test.ts`: straddling pair at the body cap (fails pre-fix), exact-fit pair at the cap (stays intact), and an under-cap body (unchanged).
- [ ] Existing roadmap-annotations test suite passes.
